# Hypermandala

Canonical: https://hypermandala.mariomarcolongo.com/
Source: https://github.com/jnton/hypermandala
Creator: Mario Marcolongo — https://mariomarcolongo.com/

Hypermandala is an interactive browser-based geometry explorer for mandalas, yantras, sacred geometry, and architecture-inspired geometric plans.

It lets users move from exact 2D plans to hierarchy-aware 3D forms and projected 4D hyperforms. The 4D model supports the six rotation planes XY, XZ, YZ, XW, YW, and ZW, plus perspective, orthographic, and isometric projection.

Specific geometric families include:
- Sri Yantra / Sri Chakra
- Kali Yantra
- Matangi Yantra
- Square mandala
- Hexagonal mandala
- Stupa
- Borobudur-inspired geometry
- Castel del Monte
- Kukulcán
- Bete Giyorgis

For non-architectural forms, users can compare a hierarchy-first Z lift with an experimental reflection-symmetric Mirror lift. Dimensional collapse preserves the source geometry.

Hypermandala is open source under GNU AGPL v3 or later.
